WITH rep_customer_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    e.EmployeeId,
    e.City,
    COUNT(c.CustomerId) as customer_count
  FROM Employee e
  JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
  GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City
),
rep_with_city_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    EmployeeId,
    City,
    customer_count,
    AVG(customer_count) OVER (PARTITION BY City) as city_avg
  FROM rep_customer_counts
),
filtered_reps AS (
  SELECT 
    EmployeeId,
    City,
    customer_count,
    city_avg
  FROM rep_with_city_avg
  WHERE customer_count > city_avg
),
total_customers_overall AS (
  SELECT SUM(customer_count) as total FROM filtered_reps
),
city_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    City,
    SUM(customer_count) as total_customers,
    AVG(customer_count - city_avg) as avg_above_average,
    AVG(customer_count * 1.0 / (SELECT total FROM total_customers_overall)) as avg_share
  FROM filtered_reps
  GROUP BY City
)
SELECT * FROM city_summary
ORDER BY City
